crossRefs.note: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in…
and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat…
For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

translations.web: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.
translations.bsb: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.
